**Finding: missing (critical) — no indemnity anywhere in the Agreement.**

- Searches for "indemnif", "hold harmless" and "liability" turned up nothing relevant; Section 9 (Warranties) covers only corporate authority reps and the Globix carve-out, and Section 10 (General Provisions) has no defence or liability allocation.
- Because HDI designs, hosts, operates and supplies the software/technology behind the Site, the total absence of an HDI IP-infringement indemnity is walk-away territory under INDEMN.
- Redline (validated, ok:true): new Section 9(c) giving the Company a defend/indemnify/hold-harmless right for (1) IP infringement claims relating to the Site/Services/HDI materials (carving out Company-supplied Content), (2) HDI's breach of law, (3) unauthorised access to Content/Confidential Information/user data caused by HDI, and (4) HDI's gross negligence or wilful misconduct, with standard notice, control-of-defence (no adverse settlement without our consent) and cooperation-at-HDI's-expense mechanics.
- Placement inside Section 9 also picks up the existing Section 10.7 survival list. No Company-side indemnity was added; an IP-only fallback with customary exclusions and procure/modify/replace remedies is offered in the comment.
